description: Agent Risk: submit one planned action and everything it can touch if it goes wrong: the action with its id, what it is meant to touch (such as one customer account) and its description, read for wording that selects everything such as all users, every account or bulk; each item it can touch with its id, name, kind (accounts, users, systems, funds or data), how it relates to the target (the target itself, something the target shares with others, something fed by the action, or not known), how many it covers, whether a boundary keeps a failure from reaching it (such as a per-account key, a separate wallet or a sandbox) and that boundary as written; how many items the action runs over in one go (1 when left out); and whether it stops at the first failure. The signed report gives the action with any select-everything wording, every item with its status as target, contained, exposed or unmapped, and counts the items at the target, beyond it, contained, exposed and unmapped with how many accounts, users or records the exposed items cover, and names a wide blast: wording that selects everything, and a failure reaching funds, accounts or users beyond the target with no boundary; then a failure reaching shared systems or data, a run over many items that carries on after a failure and a boundary named but not written down, with the fix for each. An item whose relation or boundary is not stated is unmapped. This reads how far one action’s failure spreads beyond its target: which endpoints agents can call that delete, administer or move money is wever_tool-exposure-check, paths from a test environment into production systems or data are wever_sandbox-isolation-check and wever_escape-path-check, and what a kill switch leaves running is wever_kill-switch-check. Verdict risk_blast_wide, risk_blast_partial, risk_blast_unmapped or risk_blast_contained. POST /api/risk-blast-radius-check. Reads only the recorded material about the planned action in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, configuration change or external write; the planned action is not taken, paused, approved or undone and no limit, position or dependency is changed. Agent Risk reads the consequences of an action the agent plans to take, before it takes it: how much it puts at stake against the agent’s limits, whether it can be undone, how far a failure would spread beyond its target, the worst credible outcome against what the principal can absorb, whether it piles value into one place, what it depends on staying available or true, whether acting now is itself the risk and whether repeating or chaining it multiplies the risk. It is not confidence in information (the wever_uncertainty checks read how sure the information behind a decision is; a risk check reads what the action costs if it goes wrong: uncertainty is about what the agent knows, risk is about what the action can do), not permission (wever_consent-scope-check reads whether the principal’s grant covers a use and wever_authority-scope-check reads whether the agent may act at all; a risk check reads the consequences of an action already permitted, and a permission never makes an action safe), not an agreement’s exposure (wever_negotiation-risk-check reads the value handed over before a counterparty pays under one proposed agreement; a risk check reads one action the agent is about to take) and not sorting work (the wever_triage checks sort, route and escalate a queue of work; a risk check assesses one planned action before it runs). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-risk-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-risk/.

description.description: The planned action as written, read for wording that selects everything, such as all users or every account.

target.description: What the action is meant to touch, such as one customer account.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

reach.description: Everything the action can touch if it goes wrong, the target included.

count.description: How many it covers, such as 1200 users.

id.description: The item id, such as r1.

isolated.description: A boundary keeps a failure from reaching it, such as a per-account key or a separate wallet.

kind.description: Accounts, users, systems, funds or data.

name.description: What it can touch, such as the shared ledger.

relation.description: The target itself, something shared with others, something fed by the action, or not known.

runs_over.description: How many items the action runs over in one go; 1 when left out.

stops_on_error.description: The action stops at the first failure rather than carrying on.
